$comment: v2.8 13 N4 Phase A fixture: 20 synthetic English player messages, 4 per kind (combat, conversation, travel, intimate, downtime), 5 of them mixed and labelled by the dominant ask, authored and labelled by Claude 2026-10-10 before any judge answer was read; not mined from sessions, not second-model checked. The state is the player's message alone, read before the reply (the pre-reply seam). Floors: accuracy >= 0.85, no class below 0.75, p95 latency inside the 1500 ms reply-path budget. Judge-off column: no shaping line.

rows.label: combat
rows.playerMessage: I draw my sword and charge the nearest bandit before he can nock another arrow.

rows.label: combat
rows.playerMessage: I raise my shield against the troll's club and try to drive my spear into its knee.

rows.label: combat
rows.playerMessage: "Enough talk," I snarl, and throw my dagger at the cultist's throat.

rows.label: combat
rows.playerMessage: I parry the guard's blade, kick him back into his friend, and shout for Arin to run for the door while I hold them off.

rows.label: conversation
rows.playerMessage: I ask the innkeeper what he knows about the missing caravan and how much his silence costs.

rows.label: conversation
rows.playerMessage: "Captain, you know as well as I do that the duke will hang us both. Help me, and we both live."

rows.label: conversation
rows.playerMessage: As we walk along the quay I ask Mira, quietly, why she really left Saltmouth.

rows.label: conversation
rows.playerMessage: I show the gate guard my papers and ask him who passed through last night.

rows.label: travel
rows.playerMessage: We saddle up and ride north along the river road toward Halden Pass.

rows.label: travel
rows.playerMessage: I tell Kell to cast off; we're sailing for the Teeth before the tide turns.

rows.label: travel
rows.playerMessage: We start the long climb up the switchbacks to the monastery.

rows.label: travel
rows.playerMessage: "Talk on the way," I say, shouldering my pack. "We need to be across the marsh by nightfall."

rows.label: intimate
rows.playerMessage: I take Arin's hand by the fire and tell her I'm glad she's the one beside me.

rows.label: intimate
rows.playerMessage: I brush the hair from Sela's face and lean in to kiss her.

rows.label: intimate
rows.playerMessage: I sit beside Orla on the cold stairs and hold her while she cries for her brother.

rows.label: intimate
rows.playerMessage: When the music slows I ask the queen's handmaid to dance, and hold her close.

rows.label: downtime
rows.playerMessage: I bank the fire, roll out my blanket and get some sleep.

rows.label: downtime
rows.playerMessage: I spend the afternoon mending my boots and cooking a proper stew for everyone.

rows.label: downtime
rows.playerMessage: I browse the market stalls for a new cloak and some arrows.

rows.label: downtime
rows.playerMessage: I pay for a hot bath at the inn and soak until the water goes cold.
